title: Conveyor start-stop and jog
goal: A technician can trace the sealed run circuit, momentary jog path, motor output, and run indication.

rubric.must: StartPB and the ConveyorRun holding contact form visible parallel paths on the ConveyorRun output rung.
JogPB appears on a separate visible path that energises ConveyorJog, which joins ConveyorRun at ConveyorMotor.
Normally closed StopPB and OverloadTrip contacts are visibly ahead of the conveyor motor logic.
A coil labelled ConveyorMotor is visibly driven by parallel ConveyorRun and ConveyorJog contacts.
A ConveyorMotor contact visibly drives the RunLamp coil.
An OverloadTrip contact and OverloadLamp coil are visibly paired on an alarm rung.

ideal.notes: Independently hand-composed reference after visual-eval/exemplars/ladder/ideal.svg (sha256 72319743d0eb). Vision-reviewed rendered SVG against source and exemplar, including labels, connections and symbol placement. Measured spacious rung bands and consistent AB contact, coil and reset-bracket symbols. All rungs and branch membership preserved.
